Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: apply trial boost/top-up to Oct invoice + credit memo

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding — Meridian appreciated the demo last week. We have a special request from finance: we want to apply an additional trial boost (US$45,000) to our October invoice so that charges net down before month-end payment processing. Can Redwood issue a credit memo and confirm the accounting treatment so our AP team can net the credit with the upcoming invoice?

Questions from our billing side:
- Will this be a credit memo that posts against AR (so invoice netting) or a separate voucher?
- What GLA will Redwood use for the credit for our tax team?
- Who signs for approval on Redwood's side — is a one-page approval PDF sufficient?

I can attach the internal approval memo if you need it (I’ve copied our billing address as well). Appreciate a short timeline (we're trying to close Oct payments on 10/20).

Attachments: Meridian_internal_approval.pdf (stub)

Best,
Jill Park
Director, Procurement
Meridian Health

Hi Jill — thanks for flagging this and for the approval doc. Looping in Laura (Finance) and Karthik (Sales ops) so we can get the credit memo created and the AR netting scheduled.

Quick plan:
1) We will prepare a formal credit memo for $45,000 and send you a draft for sign-off.
2) Finance will confirm the GLA mapping and whether this posts against AR for invoice netting.
3) Once Meridian confirms the approval PDF, Laura will issue the memo and coordinate with our AR team for the 10/20 clearance.

Laura — can you confirm the GLA we should use for a promotional/trial stipend credit and whether any additional fields (cost center, tax code) are needed for your ERP? We may need a signed approval on Redwood letterhead; attaching the PDF Jill shared for reference.

Attached: Meridian_STIPEND_APPROVAL.pdf (attachment stub)

Logan / team — thanks for the heads up and the approval doc. For accounting:

- Treatment: we will issue a credit memo against AR tied to the original invoice series (invoice netting). That allows Meridian to apply the credit at payment time.
- GLA: use 6100.14 (Promotional allowances / contra-revenue) for the credit memo line. If Treasury needs a different mapping for tax, note that in the credit memo cover note.
- Fields required: customer account number, original invoice reference (if any), credit memo reason code (PROMO_TRIAL_BOOST), and the approver name + date.
- Approvals: a signed one-page approval PDF is sufficient. Please ensure the approver name and company domain match Meridian Billing.
- Timing: if we get signed approval by EOD 10/14, AR can post the memo and route it to collections for netting on 10/20. If approval slips, the netting will move to the next cycle.

I attached a template credit memo (we'll populate it). Logan — please confirm whether we should include the memo as "non-cash credit" or standard credit memo in the ERP; my recommendation is standard credit memo to simplify AP netting.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference — Finance
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
